Reproduce and independently verify

Run in the applied benchmark clone, with this complete site at ./site. The output directory must be new. These commands verify existing evidence and regenerate HTML; they do not rerun measurements.

set -euo pipefail
python3 -m tools.release_v020 --verify site/downloads/release --manifest-sha256 81253bc16d87be83ff1dfb11a816eaf590d9cbcc4f2568ee88ea909ad26b9c94
python3 -m tools.build_site site/downloads/release --out rebuilt-site --manifest-sha256 81253bc16d87be83ff1dfb11a816eaf590d9cbcc4f2568ee88ea909ad26b9c94

Source hashes identify bytes, not authorship. A verified scientific FAIL remains visible. No build timestamp or inferred machine is added.
